questions.question: Identify the synonym of 'Elusive':

questions.question:
Choose the correct article to complete the sentence:

"Eating _____ balanced diet is essential for good health"
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **"a"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"balanced"** means something that is arranged in good proportions to ensure stability or fairness. (संतुलित)
 
 
• **Example: **A balanced approach to work and leisure is necessary for a healthy lifestyle.
 
 

 
• **"A"** is an indefinite article used before singular, countable nouns that begin with a consonant sound. It refers to something general, not specific. (एक)
 
 
• **Example: **She bought a book from the store.
 
 

 
• In the given sentence, the phrase "a balanced diet" talks about any balanced diet in general, not a specific one, making "a" the correct article.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 ("a")**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: "an" **(एक): "An" is used before singular, countable nouns that begin with a vowel sound (a, e, i, o, u).
 
 
• **Example:** She wants to eat an apple.
 
 

 
• **Option 3: "the" **(वह): "The" is a definite article used to refer to something specific or already known to the speaker and listener.
 
 
• **Example:** The book on the table belongs to me.
 
 

 
• **Option 4: No Article** (कोई लेख नहीं): Sometimes, no article is used before uncountable nouns or plural nouns when speaking in general terms.
 
 
• **Example:** Water is essential for life.

4. It provides us knowledge and skills for the future.
questions.solution:

• "Education plays a crucial role in our lives."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4 follows** as it elaborates on the benefits of education:
 
 
• "It provides us knowledge and skills for the future."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 3 is next** as it explains the challenges that arise without education:
 
 
• "Without education, progress in society would be difficult."

"Education plays a crucial role in our lives. It provides us knowledge and skills for the future. Without education, progress in society would be difficult. Therefore, every child deserves the opportunity to learn."</div

questions.question:
The policeman said, "Don't worry. We'll find your stolen car. We'll leave no stone unturned."

What does the phrase "We'll leave no stone unturned" mean in the policeman's statement?

options.text: They will return the car immediately.
They will not investigate the case.
They will only search in a few places.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**, i.e., "They will search everywhere thoroughly."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"leave no stone unturned"** means to make every possible effort to achieve something or to search for something thoroughly. (हर संभव प्रयास करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The rescue team left no stone unturned in their search for the missing hikers.
 

 
• **"Thoroughly"** refers to doing something in an exhaustive and detailed way, without missing any part. (पूरी तरह से)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher thoroughly checked all the students' assignments for errors.
 

 
• Hence, in the given context, the police assure that they will make every effort to find the stolen car, which aligns with the meaning of "leave no stone unturned."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: They will return the car immediately.** (वे तुरंत कार लौटा देंगे): This option is incorrect because the phrase "leave no stone unturned" refers to making an exhaustive effort, not an immediate action.
 
 
• **Example:** If they knew where the car was, they would have returned it immediately, but they still need to search thoroughly.
 
 

 
• **Option 3: They will not investigate the case.** (वे मामले की जांच नहीं करेंगे): This option is incorrect as the phrase means the exact opposite — it emphasizes thorough investigation rather than avoiding it.
 
 
• **Example:** The officers cannot leave the case uninvestigated; they must leave no stone unturned.
 
 

 
• **Option 4: They will only search in a few places.** (वे केवल कुछ स्थानों पर खोज करेंगे): This is incorrect because "leave no stone unturned" implies searching everywhere, not just in limited places.
 
 
• **Example:** A limited search would not fulfill their promise of leaving no stone unturned.

questions.question:
Amit: Where were you, Akash?

Akash: I didn't mean to leave you in the lurch. I thought we had canceled our meeting.

What does Akash mean by saying, "I didn't mean to leave you in the lurch"?

options.text: Akash didn't want to leave Amit in a difficult situation.
Akash was busy with some urgent work.
Akash forgot about the meeting completely.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Akash didn't want to leave Amit in a difficult situation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"leave someone in the lurch"** means to abandon someone in a difficult or helpless situation without assistance. (किसी को कठिन परिस्थिति में अकेला छोड़ देना)

 
 
• **Example:** John promised to help me with the project, but he left me in the lurch at the last moment.
 
 

 
• Akash is expressing that he did not intend to leave Amit in a tough or tricky situation. (आकाश यह व्यक्त कर रहा है कि उसका इरादा अमित को कठिन परिस्थिति में अकेला छोड़ने का नहीं था।)

 
 
• **Example:** Akash clarified that he misunderstood the cancellation and did not intentionally leave Amit in the lurch.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** Akash was busy with some urgent work. (आकाश किसी जरूरी काम में व्यस्त था।)
 
 
• **Example:** Akash couldn’t attend the meeting because he had some urgent work.
 

 
• **Option 3:** Akash forgot about the meeting completely. (आकाश पूरी तरह से बैठक को भूल गया।)
 
 
• **Example:** Akash apologized because he completely forgot about the meeting.
 

 
• **Option 4:** Akash was intentionally avoiding Amit. (आकाश जानबूझकर अमित से बच रहा था।)
 
 
• **Example:** Amit thought Akash was avoiding him, but that wasn’t the case.
